# Trump and Chinese president Xi end summit without major agreement on AI Donald Trump and Chinese president Xi Jinping wrapped up [their Washington summit](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/25/donald-trump-xi-jinping-china-president-us-visit-red-carpet-treatment) on Friday, facing criticism that they had squandered an opportunity to pause their countries’ artificial intelligence (AI) arms race.
But Trump – who has repeatedly said the US must forge ahead to maintain its lead over [China](https://www.theguardian.com/world/china) – appeared more focused on his push to rebrand artificial intelligence as “super intelligence”, later claiming on social media that Xi “seems to like” the term without divulging the substance of their discussions.
